criteria.description: The mission starts normally and reaches a controllable flight state.
Pitch, yaw, roll, throttle, acceleration, chase camera, terrain collision, and horizon cues combine into stable, readable flight.
Cannon and limited missiles behave distinctly, and a visible lock sequence precedes genuinely guided missile behavior.
Three ground emplacements and two airborne interceptors are distinguishable, attack or evade readably, take damage, and can be destroyed.
Victory requires destroying all five targets and then visibly flying through the extraction gate; reaching a count of five must not auto-win before extraction.
Health, enemy attacks, lethal terrain impacts, timer, ammunition or cooldown, and target progression create observable mission pressure.
Canyon route, aircraft, targets, extraction, radar or directional cues, HUD, impacts, and speed remain readable in motion.
At 390 x 844 flight, throttle, cannon, and missile controls are reachable and the forward route and mission HUD remain visible.
